scope: Design-stage adjudication by exact synthetic flopscope billing; no source was built and no data touched.

findings.l5_not_implementable: The host carries no fifth-order cumulant state, so the L5 group requires new state machinery outside this node's licensed scope.
findings.note: Marginals exclude the additional weight-construction cost (k3*k4 and k3^3 plane products) and wider coefficient gathers, which only worsen every case.

verdict: Every implementable lambda^3 Edgeworth channel group exceeds the exact 2^41 headroom at the current host total; the L5 group is not implementable without new cumulant state. Together with the T closure (the Mehler tail is cost-admissible but effect-capped at 1.6e-5 of the error scale), the series-refinement family is measured out: within the budget, the Q24 closure's expansion orders sit at their cost frontier and the sub-leading terms that fit do not matter.
standing_question: The only direction left open by the combined S/T/U receipts is reallocation: whether any existing host component delivers little error reduction per FLOP, so its budget could fund the L3*L4 shell (needs about 70e9). That is a value-attribution question requiring lawful truth on observer_fit and end-to-end measurement, respecting the partial-fix and co-adaptation laws.
